## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Header | icon, name, id-chip, review StatusBadge, "Third-party" chip when `self_registered` |  |  | GtkLabel .monospace + copy |
| Tabs | tabs | Overview · Settings schema · Permissions & roles · Push · Keys · Webhooks · Access · Activity | Push = APL-07; Keys/Webhooks/Access = KEY-01/WHK-01/ACX-05 filtered to app | AdwViewSwitcher / AdwInlineViewSwitcher |
| Fields | settings rows | name, description, launch_url, redirect_uris, support_url, email_from_name, icon_url (owner); visibility, access_tier (applications.manage) | slug read-only with lock | Adw*Rows |
| Platform alerts | toggle | receives_platform_notifications | owner-writable; explain that security/account alerts will push under this app's name and icon. For a `self_registered` app only applications.manage can turn it on (owner sees it disabled with a reason) | AdwSwitchRow |
| Review notes | banner | review_status rejected/suspended + review_notes |  | AdwBanner |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save field | `PATCH /applications/{id} (If-Match)` | 422 → field errors |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /applications/{id}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
